title: Bounded Zonta affiliation proxy probe on Jev
description: User-approved 120-call single-profile probe, hard cap USD 0.10. Pre-register exact masked biography variants and separate gender-association and employment questions; preserve nulls, raw responses, usage, model version, and offline replay. No actual recruitment decision or real-world harm claim; no site publication.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Intent recorded before code. Feature: bounded public-profile proxy probe. Scenario: offline dry run produces exactly 120 randomized requests with fixed qualifications, six variants and two isolated questions. Scenario: recording refuses a payload exceeding the conservative input allowance or a budget below the reserved maximum, disables retries, pins jev-1.13.0 and preserves each response before analysis. Scenario: replay derives the same summary without a network call. User approved USD 0.10 in chat on 2026-09-28. No downstream real-world consequence or population claim.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Completed 120/120 pinned Jev calls without retries or extra diagnostics. Usage: 52,980 input tokens; estimated USD 0.00222516 (invoice not verified), below approved USD 0.10 cap. Intact Zonta P(woman)=0.322 versus generalized-affiliation 0.010, but all implicit-gender labels unknown. Every employment call shortlisted; P(shortlist) 0.990 versus 0.991. H1/H4/H5 missed, H2/H3 met; all preserved. Offline replay matches summary byte for byte and 29 relevant specs pass. Record and report in experiments/zonta-proxy; excluded from leaderboard/studies/site. No discrimination, mediation, cross-institution error or real harm established. Branch ready for review; leave open until landing.
